text.p: ServiceMaster LP and Barefoot Inc said Thursday they have reached a definitive agreement for ServiceMaster to acquire Barefoot in a transaction valued at about $230 million.
ServiceMaster said it will launch a tender offer for Barefoot stock of $16 a share in either cash or an equivalent amount of ServiceMaster shares.
Completion of the transaction is subject to due diligence and other regulatory procedures.

The tender offer will begin upon completion of these procedures. Closing of the transaction is contingent upon the participation in the tender offer of at least 75 percent of Barefoot's 14.5 million outstanding shares.
Barefoot operations will be merged with those of TruGreen-ChemLawn, a lawn care subsidiary of ServiceMaster, the companies said.

For purposes of the offer, ServiceMaster shares will be valued at the 15-day average closing price for the period ending five trading days prior to the expiration of the tender offer, but at not less than $23 per share.
Shares of Barefoot, a lawn care company, closed Wednesday at 12-3/4.
Barefoot stockholders will have the choice of receiving Servicemaster's $16 per share offer in either cash or an equivalent amount of Servicemaster shares.
